ENG_economic_recovery_category = {

	# Special Area tyneside (state 131): +1 infrastructure (up to level 5) and +1 building slot, paid on completion.
	ENG_special_area_tyneside = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_civil_support
		allowed = { original_tag = ENG }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = ENG_special_areas_act
			owns_state = 131
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ENG_special_area_tyneside_done }
		}
		available = {
			has_full_control_of_state = 131
			num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects > 4
		}
		highlight_states = { highlight_state_targets = { state = 131 } }
		cost = 25
		days_remove = 150
		modifier = {
			civilian_factory_use = 5
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_full_control_of_state = 131 }
		}
		remove_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ENG_special_area_tyneside_done
			131 = {
				if = {
					limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}

ENG_shadow_factories_category = {

	# Shadow Factory 1 of 2 (state 128): +1 military factory and +1 building slot there if held and with room,
	# else in another British home state, else offsite. Paid on completion only.
	ENG_shadow_factory_castle_bromwich = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_factory
		allowed = { original_tag = ENG }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = ENG_aero_engine_shadow_factories
		}
		available = {
			date > 1937.1.1
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ENG_shadow_factory_in_progress }
			check_variable = { ENG_shadow_factories_built < 2 }
			num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects > 4
		}
		highlight_states = { highlight_state_targets = { state = 128 } }
		cost = 50
		days_remove = 280
		fire_only_once = yes
		modifier = {
			civilian_factory_use = 5
		}
		complete_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ENG_shadow_factory_in_progress
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			has_capitulated = yes
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = ENG_shadow_factory_in_progress
		}
		remove_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = ENG_shadow_factory_in_progress
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ENG_shadow_factories_built < 2 } }
				add_to_variable = { ENG_shadow_factories_built = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						128 = {
							is_core_of = ROOT
							is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT
							free_building_slots = {
								building = arms_factory
								size > 0
								include_locked = yes
							}
						}
					}
					128 = {
						add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
						add_building_construction = {
							type = arms_factory
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					ENG_economy_grant_mil = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}
